title: End of session
summary: Confirm the furnace is cool and closed, isolate the gas supply, leave the controls and exhaust in their approved idle state, and record the session. Written from the published sequence (Nano Lett. 2025, 25, 10123) and general tube-furnace practice; flows, pressures and ramp rates are blanks for the instrument owner to fill.

steps.title: Confirm the furnace housing is closed and the tube is cool
steps.body: Confirm that the furnace housing is closed and the tube is cool.

steps.title: Close the argon valve and restore the outlet configuration
steps.body: Close the argon valve, restore the outlet/exhaust configuration, and release any vacuum as required.

steps.title: Switch off the water cooler and leave the controller idle
steps.body: Switch off the water cooler and dispose of the ice bath. Leave the controller idle.

steps.title: Record the session in the logbook
steps.body: Record the sample id, sulfur mass, and program used in the logbook.
